t: You've arrived at the David Bowie Centre, a museum in London devoted to David Bowie. Born David Robert Jones, he was an English singer, songwriter and actor, and is regarded as one of the most influential musicians of the twentieth century. He was known for reinventing himself again and again, and for his striking visual presentation, which earned him the nickname the chameleon of rock. His music, stagecraft and fashion left a real mark on popular culture, and that is what this place is here to commemorate.
